concept: Curiosity as a lifelong habit, not just a school subject — noticing what you're drawn to outside of assignments
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student reflects on what they explore purely for their own interest, unprompted by school or assignments
exercise.branching_choice: Student identifies patterns in what draws their attention when no one is grading it
exercise.practice: Student names one thing they've taught themselves just because they wanted to know it

assessment.success_marker: student identifies a genuine self-directed interest, distinct from anything assigned
